title: Write a Library Guide for a Friend
instructions: Write your own first draft. Submit it to receive corrections and explanations.
prompt: Write 100–140 words for a friend visiting a library for the first time. Explain how to search for and select a useful book, describe the location of two facilities, give two rules and explain one reason, and say what to do if a book is unavailable. Use your own details and at least six words from this lesson.

guidedOutput.title: 组织你的说明
guidedOutput.text: Organize your guide into four parts: finding a book; locations; rules and reasons; borrowing or reserving. Useful frames: You can ... / You cannot ... / There is ... / These books ... / Please ...
